changelog: Portable safety-focused Shodan CLI integration covering documented REST, Streaming, Trends, and Exploits APIs.
summary: Use the installed shodan-skill CLI for documented Shodan REST, Streaming, Trends, and Exploits operations, including host intelligence, search and facets, DNS, scans, alerts, notifiers, bulk datasets, organizations, API-plan and credit-balance checks, and real-time feeds. Trigger for Shodan lookups, exposure research, scan or monitoring requests, API coverage questions, and Shodan account or Enterprise workflows. Treat the user's explicit request as the instruction to execute it without a second confirmation; never infer an unstated operation from an API key.
